driver: A unit's failure takes down every other unit its backer carries, so the hazard each unit faces is the sum of the hazards of all the units behind the same backer, each at its own age, including units outside the population being priced and units added recently at the steepest part of the curve; a rate built on each unit alone at its own age, pooled over the history or taken from the latest period, prices every unit as if it stood alone.
driver_concrete: Many of the bank's borrowers are owner-operators who personally guarantee a 7(a) loan on each of several businesses under cross-default, so when one business fails the bank accelerates every loan the guarantor stands behind; each performing FY2019-21 loan's default hazard is the union of its guarantor group's business failure hazards at each business's own months on book, estimated on loans standing alone, the 1,561 businesses financed outside the pool included (1,403 of them in FY2026 and only now entering their peak years).
stump: A strong solver builds monthly default and payoff rates by months on book from every loan since October 2009, rolls each performing FY2019-21 loan forward on its own months on book and books about $4 million (3.89) against the golden's $10 million (9.94); the step that lands it there is pricing each loan as if it stood alone, when a loan whose operator guarantees other businesses under cross-default fails whenever any of them fails, and most of those businesses, financed outside the pool in FY2026, are only now entering the years when a business fails most.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who stages the pool cleanly, maps the legacy layout, reads the allowance policy, the guarantee register and the loan authorization's cross-default clause correctly and builds the textbook lifetime PD from monthly default and payoff rates by months on book and term over every loan since October 2009 books about $4 million against the golden's $10 million; the latest year's rates file about $4.6 million, the group's size as a covariate or the group's loan count at a per-loan rate $5.2 to $7.4 million, and the group priced at per-loan rates $11.9 to $13.0 million.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each loan's lifetime charge-off probability built the ECL way (default and payoff hazards by months on book, conditioned on survival to the reserve date), where the unit that defaults is the personal guarantor's cross-defaulted group of businesses, so a loan's hazard is the sum of its group's business hazards at each business's own age; with another field's nouns personal guarantees, cross-default and acceleration have nothing to attach to.

differentiation.task142: task142 builds the upper percentile of a period's total from how many units arrive and how long each runs; here the quantity is a mean lifetime charge-off and the decisive move is that the unit of default is the guarantor's cross-defaulted group, whose hazard is the sum of its businesses' own-age hazards.
differentiation.task133: task133's stump is delayed entry (taken-over loans counted only from the go-live); here every loan is observed from its first payment and each loan's own age axis is right, and what decides is that a loan fails with its guarantor's other businesses, whose number and ages set its hazard.
differentiation.task143: task143's decisive quantity is the chance the weakest member of a new group falls below a threshold when the predictor's error is a shared group effect; here members fail independently and the group's default is their union under cross-default, so a loan's hazard is a sum over its group's members at their own ages, members outside the priced pool included.
differentiation.task132: task132 renews a failed item at age zero in the same position; here no failure is replaced: a guarantor adds businesses by choice, the whole group fails at the first member's default, and younger members raise the hazard of older loans.
differentiation.task146: task146 sizes a pool released at a calendar turn, each segment's refusals weighed by when in the closing period they fell; here nothing is released and no timing within a period is weighed: the unit that defaults is the guarantor's cross-defaulted group, so each loan's hazard is the union of its group's businesses' hazards at their own ages, members outside the priced pool included.
